mapper.sql: select r.room_id, r.building_id, b.building_name, r.unit_no, r.room_no, r.owner_id, r.owner_name, u.nick_name owner_nick_name, u.user_name login_account, u.phonenumber owner_phone, r.status, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark from prop_room r left join prop_building b on r.building_id = b.building_id left join sys_user u on r.owner_id = u.user_id
mapper.insert: insert into prop_room(building_id, unit_no, room_no, owner_id, owner_name, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{buildingId}, #{unitNo}, #{roomNo}, #{ownerId}, #{ownerName}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update prop_room building_id = #{buildingId},unit_no = #{unitNo},room_no = #{roomNo},owner_id = #{ownerId},owner_name = #{ownerName},status = #{status},remark = #{remark},update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where room_id = #{roomId}
mapper.delete: delete from prop_room where room_id in #{id}
